services.name: Website chat assistant
services.summary: Website chat bot that goes on the client's existing website, answers routine questions from the business's approved information and sends visitors to the business's existing booking page.
features: Goes on the client's existing website, only once the client says so
Answers routine visitor questions from approved business information
Directs visitors to existing booking pages
When it cannot answer, gives the shop's own phone number and hours

services.name: Telephone / phone assistant
services.summary: 24/7 telephone assistant that answers phone calls, handles several callers at once during morning rushes, answers routine questions from the shop's own information, and gives the shop's own number and hours when it can't answer.
features: Answers calls 24/7 including morning rushes and holidays
Parallel call handling so callers do not get busy signals or voicemail
Natural phone conversations without press-1 menus
Available after hours and on holidays, not just during opening times
Local BC area code numbers (236, 250, 604) or call forwarding from existing line

offer_tiers.name: Free demo
offer_tiers.headline: A demo built from your own website
offer_tiers.lede: We read your public website and build a demo from what you've already published. You get a private link and number to try it.
bullet_points: Answers questions using your own published info
No passwords, logins or system access
Try it yourself and show your staff
Nothing goes on your site unless you say so
offer_tiers.starting_rule: Every business starts with the free demo. We never ask for passwords or system access up front. First you see a demo built from your own website.

offer_tiers.name: Free 7-day trial
offer_tiers.headline: Free 7-day live trial and day-7 report
offer_tiers.lede: Free 7-day live trial using public business information only, with no passwords or system access. We monitor the bots' interactions for the 7 days. The shop forwards calls nobody answers, including busy and after-hours calls, to our number; the shop sets up forwarding itself. The chat goes on the shop site for 7 days. Only calls and chats the bots handle are recorded, with notice. The day-7 report lists calls and chats taken, how many were after hours, how many the bot answered fully versus pointed to the shop's open hours or website, top questions, and what we fixed.
bullet_points: Shop forwards missed calls itself; no system access
Only bot-handled calls and chats are recorded, with notice
We monitor the bots' interactions for the 7 days
Day-7 report: calls and chats taken, after-hours count, how many the bot answered fully versus pointed to the shop's open hours or website, top questions, what we fixed
offer_tiers.notes: Trial: missed calls only. Monthly: all calls 24/7.

offer_tiers.name: Monthly plan
offer_tiers.headline: The bots keep answering, every month
offer_tiers.lede: On the monthly plan the phone bot answers all the shop's calls, 24/7, and the chat stays on the shop's site. Prices are in status.pricing_and_commercials.
bullet_points: Answers from the shop's own approved information
Gives the shop's own number and hours when it can't answer

website_chat.state: Answers from Alpine Wave's approved information
website_chat.description: The website chat answers using Alpine Wave's approved information, through either prepared answers or a model-enabled path. Context stays in open browser memory (latest 16 messages); refreshing clears chat. It does not store transcripts or connect to staff inboxes, bookings, payments, or live inventory.

phone_assistant.description: Alpine Wave's own phone line (236) 760-3002 is answered by its phone assistant: a Retell Conversation Flow agent, prompt v1.6, imported from the T117 build and tested in T49. The interactive speech sample on the website is a scripted illustration.
phone_assistant.limits: Alpine Wave's own phone assistant on (236) 760-3002 cannot book, take payments, arrange callbacks, or transfer calls, nor commit to free trials. It must not claim a call was transferred, a callback arranged, or details passed on.

One interaction is one call or chat of up to 3 minutes. Launch offer for the first 3 shops: no setup fee and half price for the first 3 months. We will be able to properly evaluate cost after we know your volume. Free demo, free 7-day trial, then a monthly plan.

handoff_topics.reason: Setup timelines depend on business requirements, site platform and phone setup. No setup time is promised.
handoff_topics.route: Agreed after reviewing website and business information.

handoff_topics.reason: The bots do not connect to stock, calendar, booking or POS systems; that is not built. Whether the chat fits a particular website platform is checked against the client's setup.

handoff_topics.topic: Large group bookings and custom packages (Client workflows)
handoff_topics.reason: Groups of 10 or more, corporate packages, and custom catering require management review and cannot be quoted automatically.
Assistant must never provide medical or personalized safety clearances.
handoff_topics.route: Referred directly to certified guides and safety coordinators.

when_unsure.guarantee: No assistant can promise it will never be wrong. Alpine Wave's assistants answer only from the business's approved information. When an assistant is not certain, it says so instead of guessing and gives the business's own phone number and hours.
when_unsure.website_chat: Says it is not sure and gives the business's own phone number and hours (and email if the visitor asks). For Alpine Wave's own website chat, which is not connected to staff inboxes, that means giving the visitor Alpine Wave's email address, hello@alpinewave.ca.
when_unsure.phone_assistant: For client phone assistants, says it is not sure and gives the shop's own phone number and hours (and email if the caller asks); it does not take messages or transfer calls. This does not describe Alpine Wave's own phone assistant.

client_assistant.business_information: The client's assistant answers questions about that business's own prices, opening hours and policies from its approved information. If a detail is missing, it says it is not sure and gives the business's own phone number and hours, as described in when_unsure. It never invents a price or opening hours.
client_assistant.live_stock: The assistant cannot check live stock or availability; it is not connected to the business's stock, calendar or POS. It says so and directs the customer to the business itself.
client_assistant.bookings: The assistant directs customers to the business's existing booking pages. It does not book, reserve or hold gear, and does not take payment.
client_assistant.customer_messages: The assistant does not text the caller or the business's customers.
client_assistant.customer_contacts: The client's customers are directed to that business's own phone, email, booking pages or staff, never to Alpine Wave. Alpine Wave's phone and email are only for people asking about Alpine Wave.
client_assistant.scope: This block describes assistants supplied to client businesses. The current-channel limits in not_offered[*] and status.* describe Alpine Wave's own website chat and phone, not the capabilities a client buys. General rules there about approved information, no guessing, no up-front system access and client approval still apply to client assistants.
